name.ja: 古典的RK4
ロジスティック個体群増殖

note.ja: 収容力Kを持つ密度依存の連続時間増殖モデル。離散ロジスティック写像とは区別します。 限定した実行例：無次元の単一個体群。RK4を全出力時刻で解析解と比較し、非負性と刻み幅の収束を確認。反応拡散・複数種は対象外。 この問題に関連する代表式です。初期条件・境界条件・パラメータは「図と問題の条件・根拠」と各実行例で確認できます。
note.en: Density-limited growth with carrying capacity K. It is the simplest biological ODE baseline. The linked original is the later 1847 memoir; the 1838 note itself was not audited. The differential equation is not the discrete logistic map. Scoped executed example: One dimensionless population. Compare RK4 with the analytic solution at every output time; check nonnegativity and time refinement. Excludes reaction–diffusion and multispecies models. Representative equations related to this problem. See the image/problem conditions and each execution example for initial conditions, boundary conditions and parameters.

name.ja: SIR・SEIR区画モデル

note.ja: 閉じた一様混合集団の規格化SIR系。SEIRは曝露区画を追加します。人数と割合ではβの定義が異なります。 限定した実行例：閉鎖・均質な人口割合SIR。RK4と別実装のSciPy DOP853を比較。人口保存・非負性・時間収束を確認。SEIR・空間伝播・実データ較正は対象外。 この問題に関連する代表式です。初期条件・境界条件・パラメータは「図と問題の条件・根拠」と各実行例で確認できます。
note.en: Closed, well-mixed normalized population fractions. SEIR adds an exposed compartment and a progression rate. The original general epidemic framework is broader than this SIR specialization. Population-count and fraction conventions give different β definitions. Scoped executed example: Closed homogeneous population-fraction SIR. Compare RK4 with independently implemented SciPy DOP853; check conservation, nonnegativity and time convergence. Excludes SEIR, spatial spread and calibration to observations. Representative equations related to this problem. See the image/problem conditions and each execution example for initial conditions, boundary conditions and parameters.

note.ja: 収容力Kを持つ密度依存の連続時間増殖モデル。離散ロジスティック写像とは区別します。 限定した実行例：無次元の単一個体群。RK4を全出力時刻で解析解と比較し、非負性と刻み幅の収束を確認。反応拡散・複数種は対象外。
note.en: Density-limited growth with carrying capacity K. It is the simplest biological ODE baseline. The linked original is the later 1847 memoir; the 1838 note itself was not audited. The differential equation is not the discrete logistic map. Scoped executed example: One dimensionless population. Compare RK4 with the analytic solution at every output time; check nonnegativity and time refinement. Excludes reaction–diffusion and multispecies models.

name.ja: Michaelis–Mentenと完全酵素反応系

note.ja: 酵素・基質・複合体の反応と飽和速度則。完全反応系、迅速平衡近似、準定常近似の違いは解説先へ。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Enzyme saturation; the full mass-action system resolves the transient complex C, while the rate law eliminates a fast variable. The 1913 rapid-equilibrium interpretation and the 1925 quasi-steady-state derivation must remain distinct. Literature-only.

name.ja: Lotka–Volterra捕食・被食

note.ja: 捕食・被食の結合ODE。位相平面と長時間積分を考えるためのモデルです。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Coupled prey growth and predation; a phase-plane and long-time integration test.  Literature-only.

name.ja: McKendrick年齢構造個体群

note.ja: 年齢aに沿う輸送と死亡、新生個体の非局所な更新境界を持つモデルです。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Individuals move through age a at unit speed; newborns enter through a nonlocal renewal boundary. This is the classical age-transport form; the later von Foerster lineage is acknowledged without treating its date as the first appearance. Literature-only.

note.ja: 閉じた一様混合集団の規格化SIR系。SEIRは曝露区画を追加します。人数と割合ではβの定義が異なります。 限定した実行例：閉鎖・均質な人口割合SIR。RK4と別実装のSciPy DOP853を比較。人口保存・非負性・時間収束を確認。SEIR・空間伝播・実データ較正は対象外。
note.en: Closed, well-mixed normalized population fractions. SEIR adds an exposed compartment and a progression rate. The original general epidemic framework is broader than this SIR specialization. Population-count and fraction conventions give different β definitions. Scoped executed example: Closed homogeneous population-fraction SIR. Compare RK4 with independently implemented SciPy DOP853; check conservation, nonnegativity and time convergence. Excludes SEIR, spatial spread and calibration to observations.

name.ja: Fisher–KPP侵入前線

note.ja: 拡散と増殖を結ぶ侵入前線。表示は規格化した代表形で、波の速度と境界条件は解説先へ。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Spatial spread of an invading population or advantageous allele, represented by a reaction–diffusion front. Fisher–KPP is a conventional family name; the independent KPP 1937 original remains an archival follow-up. The exact special speed is not the minimal speed. Literature-only.

name.ja: Monod増殖とケモスタット

note.ja: 基質S、菌体X、収率Y、希釈率dの代表形。d=0の閉鎖バッチとケモスタットを区別します。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Nutrient-limited biomass X, substrate S, yield Y and chemostat dilution d; d=0 gives a closed batch model. This writes one constant-yield extension of saturation growth, not a universal metabolic model. Literature-only.

name.ja: Hodgkin–Huxley膜動態

note.ja: 電位とゲート変数z=m,h,nの膜モデル。元のイカ軸索モデルと、人心筋や空間ケーブルへの拡張を区別します。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Voltage and gating variables z=m,h,n describe an ionic excitable membrane. A cable extension adds spatial axial current. The original squid-axon model is not a calibrated human cardiac model. No single rate parameter set is selected by this survey. Literature-only.

name.ja: Turing反応拡散の枠組み

note.ja: 2成分反応拡散の枠組み。f・gは個別に指定する必要があり、模様の画像だけでTuring機構とは判定できません。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。一般の模様選択、2次元、生物実験への較正、流体連成には広げません。
note.en: A framework for diffusion-driven pattern onset around a homogeneous reaction equilibrium, not a unique choice of f and g. A spot image or unequal diffusion coefficients alone do not establish a Turing mechanism. Boundary conditions determine the available modes. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim.

name.ja: FitzHugh–Nagumoの興奮と回復

note.ja: 高速の興奮と低速の回復を結ぶ規格化した代表形。係数・符号・空間拡張には複数の規約があります。 限定した実行例：公開実行例はD=0の空間なしの縮約ODEです。FHN/BVP型の縮約ODEの限定検証です。HH全イオンチャネル、空間軸索、患者データ、実測電気生理の再現を含みません。
note.en: A normalized fast excitation/slow recovery model for pulses, refractoriness and spiral waves when extended in space. This is a common normalized variant; cubic coefficients, recovery signs and nondimensionalization differ between formulations. Scoped executed example: The executed case has D=0 and no spatial coordinate. Scoped verification of an FHN/BVP-style reduced ODE. It excludes full HH ion channels, spatial axons, patient data and experimental electrophysiology reproduction.

name.ja: Keller–Segel走化性

note.ja: 細胞密度が化学物質の勾配に応答する2場の代表的な縮約系。次元・境界・化学場の動態が重要です。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Cell density n drifts up a chemoattractant gradient; τc=0 gives an elliptic chemical subproblem. This is a common two-field reduction of a more detailed original formulation. Blowup thresholds depend on dimension, domain, boundary and chemical dynamics. Literature-only.

name.ja: Gierer–Meinhardt活性化・抑制

note.ja: 短距離活性化・長距離抑制の簡略代表形。飽和項や基礎生成項には複数の変種があります。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: A representative simplified short-range activation/long-range inhibition model. Source densities, saturation and baseline production vary across the model family. This simplified formula is not a verbatim transcription of every original variant. Literature-only.

name.ja: 流体・弾性構造と埋め込み境界

note.ja: 流体と変形構造の結合の入口。構造の力・構成則が別途必要で、既存の非圧縮ソルバーだけで実装済みとはなりません。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Fluid coupled to a deformable structure; biological examples include valves and membranes, once a force/constitutive law is supplied. Immersed boundary is a numerical coupling method, not itself a closed biological constitutive equation. The existing periodic MAC solver does not implement this coupling. Literature-only.

name.ja: 化学マスター方程式とGillespie SSA
name.en: Chemical master equation and Gillespie SSA

note.ja: 整数分子数n、反応ジャンプνj、傾向関数ajの確率モデル。Gillespie SSAは軌道を標本化する解法で、反応網自体とは区別します。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Integer molecule counts, reaction jumps νj and propensities aj; SSA samples paths of this continuous-time Markov model. The 1977 paper is a foundational SSA reference, not a priority claim for all master equations. SSA is a solver; the reaction network is the model. A seed documents a trajectory, not an ensemble validation. Literature-only.

name.ja: Mackey–Glass遅延生理フィードバック

note.ja: 遅延を持つフィードバックODE。初期値1点だけでなく、遅延区間の履歴関数が必要です。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Delayed feedback in a normalized physiological control model; delay can change stability and oscillatory behavior. A scalar initial value alone is insufficient. The delayed ODE is distinct from a spatial reaction–diffusion model. Literature-only.

name.ja: レプリケータ進化ゲーム動態

note.ja: 利得行列Aに対する戦略割合の動態。定常点と進化的安定戦略の同一視はしません。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Strategy fractions reproduce according to relative payoff in a specified matrix game. No universal Lyapunov function or equivalence of fixed point and evolutionarily stable strategy is assumed. Literature-only.

name.ja: Schnakenberg反応拡散

note.ja: 自己触媒反応の空間拡張。反応平衡と分散関係から模様の発生を検証するための数理モデルです。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。一般の模様選択、2次元、生物実験への較正、流体連成には広げません。
note.en: A simple autocatalytic kinetic law extended in space, useful for reproducible Turing-onset tests. A mathematical chemical pattern model; matching a visual biological pattern does not calibrate it to a tissue. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim.

name.ja: Shigesada–Kawasaki–Teramoto交差拡散

note.ja: 自己拡散・交差拡散と競争を含む系。表示は環境ポテンシャルを省いた一様環境での縮約形です。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Competition with density-dependent self- and cross-dispersal can produce spatial segregation. The displayed homogeneous-environment reduction omits the original environmental-potential terms. It is not equivalent to two independent scalar diffusion equations. Literature-only.

name.ja: Gray–Scott空間自己触媒反応

note.ja: 流入・除去を持つ自己触媒反応拡散。斑点分裂の画像だけで細胞分裂や線形Turing不安定性とは判定しません。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: A chemical feed/decay model whose spatial extension supports diverse spot and wave patterns. 1983 is the well-mixed CSTR source; Pearson 1993 is the spatial pattern reference. Spot division does not by itself demonstrate cell division or a linear Turing instability. Literature-only.

name.ja: Aliev–Panfilov心筋興奮

note.ja: 心筋波の興奮・回復を表す現象論的な2変数モデル。単・双領域の組織モデルは追加の構成を要します。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: A reduced phenomenological excitation/recovery model for cardiac waves and restitution. Monodomain/bidomain tissue models add conductivity tensors and, for bidomain, an extracellular elliptic constraint. They are not automatically included by this two-variable model. Literature-only.

name.ja: Repressilator mRNA・タンパク質回路

note.ja: 3遺伝子の環状抑制。mRNAとタンパク質を残す6変数形で、振動の有無はパラメータに依存します。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Three repressing genes form a cyclic network; retaining mRNA and protein gives six state variables. The six-variable form is distinct from a reduced three-protein oscillator; oscillations are parameter-dependent. Literature-only.

name.ja: 遺伝子トグルスイッチ

note.ja: 相互抑制による規格化した2変数遺伝子スイッチ。任意のHill指数・生成率で双安定になるとは限りません。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Mutual repression produces a possible bistable genetic switch in a normalized model. Bistability is not guaranteed for arbitrary Hill exponents or production rates. Induction, mRNA dynamics and noise are additional model choices. Literature-only.
